name: GlianaAI
tagline: Say what you want made. AI picks the right image, video, voice, music model or tool, shows how it's paid, then runs it.
description:
Describe what you want: "a 5-second video of a lighthouse at dusk", "read this aloud", "30 seconds of lo-fi music", "Indonesian holidays in 2026". Tap an example to start.

Anna's AI picks the best option and writes its settings, and the plan shows how it will be paid before anything runs:
- Anna credits: Anna's own image, video, voice and music, nothing else needed.
- Free: GlianaAI's free tools (Indonesian holidays, BMKG weather and earthquake alerts, regions, prayer times, QRIS, amounts in words).
- GlianaAI balance: with your own GlianaAI key, 170+ more models and paid tools (web search, scraping, screenshots, market and SEC filings data), with the exact price shown first. Top up in rupiah with QRIS or in USDC at dashboard.glianalabs.com, no subscription.

Attach an image to edit or animate it with a GlianaAI model. A failed GlianaAI call is not charged.
